title: centaurea napulifera subsp. thirkei
intro: Centaurea napulifera subsp. thirkei, commonly known as Blue Mountain Knapweed, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving digestive issues. The plant's therapeutic actions include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These compounds contribute to the plant's ability to soothe wounds, fight off infections, and protect against oxidative stress.
